Theme.Name: Theme
Theme.Hint: How the module's windows, chat cards and map buttons look, for the whole table.

ToolWhisper.Name: Whisper the Tools Needed
ToolWhisper.Hint: When a player tries to harvest without a tool, the GM whispers them every item that would do. Turn it off to keep the tools a secret.

ResourceBook.Name: Resource Book
ResourceBook.Label: Open the Resource Book
ResourceBook.Hint: The resources players can harvest: what they give, the tools they need, and how many strikes a spot holds.

ToolSets.Name: Tool Sets
ToolSets.Label: Open the Tool Sets
ToolSets.Hint: The items that count as tools for each animation. A resource switches on the sets it takes.

Sounds.Name: Harvest Sounds
Sounds.Label: Open Harvest Sounds
Sounds.Hint: The volume of the harvest sounds for the whole table, how far they carry, and the file each one plays.

ToolSets.Title: Tool Sets
ToolSets.Empty: No tools in this set yet. Drop items from the Items directory, a compendium or a sheet.

Book.Title: Resource Book
Book.DeleteConfirm: Delete {name}? Spots on the map that use it will show a warning.
Book.CategoryHint: Group this resource in the list. With no category of its own, it sits under its animation.
Book.RestoreConfirm: Restore {name} to the version {source} provides? Your changes to it are lost.
Book.DiscardChanges: Discard the changes to this resource?
Book.VerbHint: The word on the resource's button on the map, like Mine or Chop. Left empty, the animation's own word is used.
Book.AnimationHint: Only how a strike looks and sounds. A vein, a tree or a carcass can use any of them.
Book.ToolSetsHint: Switch on the sets whose items open this resource. A set with no items can't be switched on; fill it with the toolbox button.
Book.ToolsHint: Tools for this resource alone. Any one of them, or any item of a set switched on, is enough. With neither, bare hands will do.
Book.WeightHint: Each drop's chance on one strike. Every new drop starts level with the others; slide one down to make it rarer.
Book.AmountHint: How many of the item a strike gives when it comes up.
Book.SoundHint: Empty means the resource plays its animation's default sound. Press Listen to hear it. To give this resource a sound of its own, choose a file.
Book.StrikesHint: How many strikes a spot holds before it runs dry. The GM refills it.
Book.DragHint: Drag onto the map to place a spot

Errors.GMOnly: Only a GM can do that.
Errors.TooManyTools: A resource takes at most four tools.
Errors.TooManyDrops: A resource takes at most five drops.
Errors.Twins: The same item is listed twice.
Errors.BadNumbers: A number is out of range.
Errors.FromActor: {name} exists only on a character sheet. Drop the world or compendium item instead.
Errors.NoGM: A GM must be online to harvest.
Errors.NotActiveGM: Only the active GM can run a harvest.
Errors.NotASpot: There is nothing to harvest here.
Errors.NoResource: This spot's resource no longer exists.
Errors.NotYourToken: Select a token you own first.
Errors.NotInside: Your token must stand in the spot.
Errors.NeedTool: You need a tool for this: {tools}.
Errors.BadToolSets: A Tool Set this resource uses does not exist.
Errors.Busy: Someone is already working this spot.
Errors.BrokenResource: An item this resource gives no longer exists. Tell the GM.
Errors.Failed: Nothing could be handed out, so the strike was not spent.
Errors.NoRoom: There is no free space around your token for what this would give. Make room and try again.
Errors.OnlyWebm: A resource's image can be a picture or a webm video, not another video format.
Errors.UnknownResource: There is no resource with the id {id}.
Errors.PackageResource: {name} comes from a package and can't be changed. Duplicate it in the Resource Book first.
Errors.UnknownSpot: That is not a Harvest Spot.
Errors.UnknownToken: That token could not be found.
Errors.NotOnScene: That token is not on this scene.

Spot.TypeHint: Tokens standing in this region can harvest the chosen resource until it runs dry.

remaining.label: Strikes left
remaining.hint: Starts at the resource's strikes and drops by one each strike; at 0 the spot is dry. Set any number you like.

Chat.NeedTool: Any one of these tools will do
Chat.Undelivered: {actor} harvested {resource}, but these could not be handed out: {items}. Hand them over yourself.

Sounds.Title: Harvest Sounds
Sounds.RadiusHint: How far a harvest is heard, in grid spaces. Walls and floors block it.
